title: Same Story, Different Lens: A Multi-Agent System for Cross-Outlet News Framing Analysis
title_zh: 同一故事，不同视角：用于跨媒体新闻框架分析的多智能体系统

paragraphs.en: News outlets covering the same event differ in what they emphasize and omit. Same Story, Different Lens is an experimental research prototype for comparing these choices. It collects world and politics coverage from 17 outlets, groups reports about the same event, and produces structured analyses of sentiment, political lean, framing, loaded language, possible omissions, and model-estimated proportions of factual claims and opinion. Loaded-language entries include quotations and neutral rewordings. Three model roles handle article analysis, assessment of source support, and cross-outlet briefing generation. Analyses are stored in a JSONL archive. The evaluation compares outlet-level lean estimates with approximate, predefined reference ratings and summarizes the Critic’s model-assigned grounding scores. These measures provide preliminary diagnostics. A grounding score reflects the model’s assessment of support in the supplied text and does not establish factual accuracy or constitute independent verification.
paragraphs.zh: 报道同一事件的新闻媒体在强调什么和省略什么上各不相同。 「同一事件，不同视角」是一个用于比较这些选择的实验性研究原型。 它收集来自17家媒体的世界新闻和政治报道，将关于同一事件的报道分组，并对情感倾向、政治倾向、叙事框架、情绪化用语、可能的遗漏，以及模型估计的事实性陈述与观点的比例生成结构化分析。 情绪化用语条目包含引文和中性改写。 三个模型角色分别负责文章分析、信源支持评估，以及跨媒体简报生成。 分析结果存储在 JSONL 档案中。 评估将媒体层面的倾向估计与近似的、预先定义的参考评级进行比较，并汇总评估者（Critic）被模型赋予的支撑度评分。 这些指标提供初步的诊断信息。 支撑度评分反映的是模型对所提供文本中支持程度的评估，并不能确立事实准确性，也不构成独立的事实核查。

paragraphs.en: News framing concerns the selection and emphasis that shape a report of an event, as described by Entman [ 1 ] . Comparing framing across outlets usually requires readers to examine several reports and identify differences in wording, emphasis, and missing context. Such comparisons are difficult to scale, particularly when readers need to trace an interpretation to the words that support it.
paragraphs.zh: 新闻框架涉及对事件报道进行塑造的选择与强调，正如 Entman [1] 所描述的那样。 比较不同媒体之间的框架通常需要读者查阅多篇报道，并找出措辞、强调重点以及缺失背景方面的差异。 这类比较难以规模化，尤其是当读者需要将某种解读追溯到支持它的具体词语时。

paragraphs.en: Comparing reports of the same event. Framing comparisons require reports to be matched by event. Headline overlap and bag-of-words methods provide interpretable baselines for this task. The POLITICS approach [ 10 ] uses pairs of articles about the same story to learn political leaning. Our system uses event matching to organize framing comparisons. It combines TF-IDF cosine similarity, headline Jaccard overlap, and union-find merging, without a neural text encoder.

paragraphs.en: Language models as annotators and reviewers. Language models can perform text annotation and, in some settings, outperform crowd workers [ 4 ] . They are also used to evaluate other models’ outputs [ 12 ] . Their judgments have limitations: models can express political leanings [ 11 ] , and greater model capability does not consistently prevent confident errors [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 将语言模型用作标注者和审阅者。 语言模型可以执行文本标注，并且在某些设置下能超过众包工人 [ 4 ] 。 它们还被用于评估其他模型的输出 [ 12 ] 。 它们的判断存在局限：模型可能表现出政治倾向 [ 11 ] ，而且更强的模型能力并不能始终避免自信的错误 [ 14 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Self-refinement methods ask a model to critique and revise its output [ 5 ] . Constitutional approaches use explicit principles to constrain generation [ 6 ] . Verification methods assess support for generated statements; SelfCheckGPT, for example, uses sampling to detect possible hallucinations [ 13 ] . Our Critic assesses whether the supplied article supports the Analyst’s annotations and records a model-assigned score and field-level comments. Its score is not a deterministically calculated proportion of verified claims.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进方法要求模型对其输出进行批评和修订 [ 5 ] 。 宪法式方法使用明确的原则来约束生成 [ 6 ] 。 验证方法评估对所生成陈述的支持程度；例如，SelfCheckGPT 使用采样来检测可能出现的幻觉 [ 13 ] 。 我们的 Critic 评估所提供的文章是否支持 Analyst 的标注，并记录由模型给出的评分和字段级的评论。 它的评分并不是经过确定性计算得出的已验证声明的比例。

paragraphs.en: The Analyst and Critic may share biases and failure modes. A field marked as supported records the Critic’s judgment about the supplied text; it does not establish that the article itself is factually correct. In the current implementation, the Critic’s assessments are stored as diagnostics and do not filter the Reporter’s inputs. The verified-input restriction shown in the design requires an explicit filtering mechanism.

sents.zh: 被标记为“已支持”的字段记录的是评论者对所提供文本的判断；它并不能证明文章本身在事实层面是正确的。

sents.en: In the current implementation, the Critic’s assessments are stored as diagnostics and do not filter the Reporter’s inputs.
sents.zh: 在当前实现中，评论者的评估以诊断信息的形式存储，并不会过滤报告者的输入。

sents.en: The verified-input restriction shown in the design requires an explicit filtering mechanism.
sents.zh: 设计中展示的“仅限已验证输入”的限制需要一种显式的过滤机制来实现。

paragraphs.en: The collection configuration covers 17 outlets through 19 official RSS feeds (Table 1 ). Sky News and NPR each contribute world and politics feeds; the other feeds cover world news. Figure 3 shows the outlet directory.

paragraphs.en: When an article body cannot be retrieved, the system can use the feed summary and record a body_incomplete flag. Feed failures can also reduce the sources available for comparison. The requirement for at least two outlets in a story does not remove this source-selection risk. Paywall and robots.txt compliance should be checked independently; the current ingestion implementation does not establish a general guarantee of compliance or reliable retention of the last successful crawl after every feed failure.
paragraphs.zh: 当无法获取文章正文时，系统可以使用订阅源摘要，并记录 body_incomplete 标志。 订阅源故障还可能减少可用于比较的来源。 一篇报道需要至少两个媒体渠道的要求并不能消除这种来源选择风险。 付费墙与 robots.txt 合规性应当被独立检查；当前的采集实现并未在每次订阅源故障后确立普遍的合规保证或对上次成功抓取的可靠保留。

paragraphs.en: Each article has a TF-IDF representation of headline and summary unigrams and bigrams, with document frequencies calculated over the current crawl. Headline token sets provide a second similarity measure through Jaccard overlap. A pair of articles is linked when cosine similarity reaches 0.25 0.25 or headline Jaccard similarity reaches 0.55 0.55 , provided the publication dates are no more than four days apart. Same-outlet pairs use higher thresholds of 0.45 0.45 and 0.70 0.70 . Union-find merging converts these links into connected components. The four-day rule applies to article pairs, so a component formed through several links can span a longer interval.
paragraphs.zh: 每篇文章都有标题和摘要的一元与二元词组的 TF-IDF 表示，其文档频率基于当前抓取的数据计算。 标题的词集通过 Jaccard 重叠提供第二种相似度度量。 当余弦相似度达到 0.25 0.25 或标题 Jaccard 相似度达到 0.55 0.55，且发布日期相隔不超过四天时，一对文章即被关联。 同一媒体机构的文章对使用更高的阈值 0.45 0.45 和 0.70 0.70。 并查集合并将这些关联转换为连通分量。 四天规则适用于文章对，因此通过多条关联形成的连通分量可以跨越更长的时间间隔。

paragraphs.en: A component becomes a story when it contains at least two distinct outlets. For a single-outlet component, the most recent report is retained in a separate list (Figure 4 ). Stories are ranked first by the number of outlets, then by recency, and then by article count. The service retains the top 36 stories for presentation; the homepage initially displays 12. Analysis and archiving operate on the retained selection, so the archive does not contain every ingested article.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个组件包含至少两个不同的渠道时，它就成为一条故事。 对于单渠道组件，最近的报道被保留在一个单独的列表中（图 4 ）。 故事首先按渠道数量排序，然后按时效性排序，最后按文章数量排序。 该服务保留排名前 36 的故事用于展示；首页最初显示 12 条。 分析和归档操作基于保留的选择进行，因此归档中并不包含每一篇被摄取的文章。

sents.en: A component becomes a story when it contains at least two distinct outlets.
sents.zh: 当一个组件包含至少两个不同的渠道时，它就成为一条故事。

sents.en: For a single-outlet component, the most recent report is retained in a separate list (Figure 4 ).
sents.zh: 对于单渠道组件，最近的报道被保留在一个单独的列表中（图 4 ）。

paragraphs.en: A fixed outlet-preference order selects the headline used as the topic label. This provides a consistent selection rule without establishing that the selected headline is neutral. Across crawls, URL and content overlap link a story to an earlier instance so that follow-up reports can share an identifier. These links are heuristic and do not guarantee correct event identity.
paragraphs.zh: 固定的出口偏好顺序用于选择作为主题标签的标题。 这提供了一致的选择规则，但并未证明所选标题是中立的。 在多次抓取之间，URL 和内容重叠将一条报道与更早的实例关联起来，以便后续报道可以共享一个标识符。 这些关联是启发式的，并不能保证正确的事件同一性。

sents.zh: 固定的出口偏好顺序用于选择作为主题标签的标题。

paragraphs.en: The Analyst prompt asks for quotations to support analytical claims. When evidence is insufficient, the prompt instructs the model to leave the field empty and record an insufficient_evidence_flags entry. These are prompt requirements; they do not guarantee that every returned annotation has valid support. The output schema contains eight fields:
paragraphs.zh: 分析师（Analyst）提示词要求引用内容来支持分析性论断。 当证据不足时，提示词指示模型将该字段留空，并记录一条 insufficient_evidence_flags 条目。 这些只是提示词层面的要求，并不能保证每一条返回的标注都有有效的依据支持。 输出模式（schema）包含八个字段：

sents.en: The Analyst prompt asks for quotations to support analytical claims.
sents.zh: 分析师（Analyst）提示词要求引用内容来支持分析性论断。

sents.en: When evidence is insufficient, the prompt instructs the model to leave the field empty and record an insufficient_evidence_flags entry.
sents.zh: 当证据不足时，提示词指示模型将该字段留空，并记录一条 insufficient_evidence_flags 条目。

sents.en: These are prompt requirements; they do not guarantee that every returned annotation has valid support.
sents.zh: 这些只是提示词层面的要求，并不能保证每一条返回的标注都有有效的依据支持。

sents.en: The output schema contains eight fields:
sents.zh: 输出模式（schema）包含八个字段：

paragraphs.en: sentiment : a score in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] and a five-way label from negative to positive ;
paragraphs.zh: sentiment：一个取值范围为 [ − 1 , 1 ] 的分数，以及一个从负面到正面的五分类标签；

paragraphs.en: bias_rating : a model-assigned political-lean label from left to right , or not-determinable , with a model-reported confidence value in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ;
paragraphs.zh: bias_rating：模型赋予的政治倾向标签，从 left 到 right，或 not-determinable，并带有模型报告的 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 区间内的置信度值；

paragraphs.en: framing : a one-sentence description of the article’s angle;
paragraphs.zh: framing（框定）：用一句话描述文章的切入角度；

paragraphs.en: loaded_language : up to five quotations, each with an explanation and a model-proposed neutral rewording;
paragraphs.zh: loaded_language：最多五处引文，每处附有解释以及模型提出的中性改写；

paragraphs.en: omissions : possible missing context identified by the model;
paragraphs.zh: omissions（遗漏）：模型识别出的可能缺失的上下文；

paragraphs.en: fact_vs_opinion : model-estimated percentages of factual claims and opinion;
paragraphs.zh: fact_vs_opinion : 模型估计的事实性陈述与观点的百分比；

paragraphs.en: insufficient_evidence_flags : fields for which support was insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: insufficient_evidence_flags：支持证据不足的字段。

paragraphs.en: The prompt defines bias in relation to other coverage and asks the model to describe wording and possible omissions without accusing an outlet of lying. However, the per-article Analyst does not receive the other outlets’ full articles. Its lean and omission annotations therefore cannot be treated as direct measurements of differences established by reading all reports together.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词将偏差定义为相对于其他媒体报道而言，并要求模型描述措辞及可能的遗漏，而不指责媒体撒谎。 然而，逐篇分析的分析师并不会收到其他媒体的完整文章。 因此，其倾向与遗漏标注不能被视为通过综合阅读所有报道而得出的差异的直接测量结果。

sents.zh: 提示词将偏差定义为相对于其他媒体报道而言，并要求模型描述措辞及可能的遗漏，而不指责媒体撒谎。

paragraphs.en: System instructions and the JSON schema are separate from article text. This separation would allow the methodology to be fingerprinted independently of the input, as discussed in Section 4.1 . A separate cluster-level comparison summarizes agreements and differences and identifies reports with relatively restrained or emotive wording.
paragraphs.zh: 系统指令和 JSON 模式与文章正文是分开的。 如第 4.1 节所讨论的，这种分离使得该方法论可以独立于输入被指纹识别。 单独的集群层面比较总结了共识与差异，并识别出用词相对克制或情绪化的报道。

sents.en: System instructions and the JSON schema are separate from article text.
sents.zh: 系统指令和 JSON 模式与文章正文是分开的。

sents.zh: 如第 4.1 节所讨论的，这种分离使得该方法论可以独立于输入被指纹识别。

paragraphs.en: The system reuses analyses through a URL-based cache and limits concurrent model requests. The cache does not establish that article content or method versions are unchanged. Individual analysis failures can produce deterministic fallback outputs labeled mock ; these should be distinguished from real-model outputs in evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统通过基于 URL 的缓存复用分析结果，并限制并发模型请求的数量。 该缓存并不能保证文章内容或方法版本未发生变化。 单次分析失败可能产生标记为 mock 的确定性回退输出；在评估中应将这些输出与真实模型输出区分开。

sents.zh: 该系统通过基于 URL 的缓存复用分析结果，并限制并发模型请求的数量。

paragraphs.en: The Critic receives the article text and the Analyst’s output. It returns a verification_score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , lists of supported and unsupported fields, and suggested corrections. The model supplies the score directly. The program does not derive it from a fixed count of supported fields, and the field lists do not determine its value. The Critic does not receive human annotations. We use its mean score as an automated diagnostic of assessed source support.
paragraphs.zh: 评估者（Critic）接收文章文本和分析者（Analyst）的输出。 它返回一个在 [0,1] 区间内的 verification_score、被支持和未被支持字段的列表，以及建议的修改。 该分数由模型直接给出。 程序不会从被支持字段的固定数量推导出该分数，字段列表也不决定其取值。 评估者不接收人工标注。 我们将其平均分数用作评估来源支持度的自动化诊断指标。

paragraphs.en: The Reporter receives story digests containing topics, outlet counts, sentiment and lean summaries, claims shared across reports, and coverage differences. Its prompt requests a headline, a plain-language summary, one to four coverage divergences, and implications. The requested number of divergences is a prompt instruction rather than a strictly enforced output constraint. The current Reporter does not use the Critic’s score or field lists to filter its inputs.
paragraphs.zh: Reporter 接收新闻报道摘要，其中包含主题、媒体数量、情绪与倾向总结、跨报道共享的说法以及报道差异。 其提示词要求生成一个标题、一段通俗易懂的摘要、一到四条报道差异以及相关影响。 所要求的差异数量是提示词中的指令，而非严格强制执行的输出约束。 当前的 Reporter 并不使用 Critic 的评分或字段列表来过滤其输入。

sents.en: The Reporter receives story digests containing topics, outlet counts, sentiment and lean summaries, claims shared across reports, and coverage differences.
sents.zh: Reporter 接收新闻报道摘要，其中包含主题、媒体数量、情绪与倾向总结、跨报道共享的说法以及报道差异。

paragraphs.en: Briefings run on a configurable schedule, with a default interval of five hours, rather than after every crawl. This limits repeated model requests but does not guarantee a successful briefing at every scheduled time. Figure 5 shows the newsroom view.
paragraphs.zh: 简报按可配置的时间表运行，默认间隔为五小时，而不是在每次抓取之后运行。 这限制了重复的模型请求，但并不保证在每个计划时间都能成功生成简报。 图 5 展示了新闻编辑室视图。

paragraphs.en: The JSONL archive stores analysis and verification outputs for later evaluation. The reproducibility design specifies three additional mechanisms:
paragraphs.zh: JSONL 归档文件存储分析与验证输出，以供后续评估使用。 可复现性设计规定了另外三种机制：

sents.zh: 可复现性设计规定了另外三种机制：

paragraphs.en: Prompt fingerprinting would identify system instructions and the schema with a SHA-256 hash and record the fingerprint and temperature for each analysis. Content-addressed snapshots and an index would preserve the corresponding prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 提示指纹识别将通过 SHA-256 哈希来识别系统指令和模式，并为每次分析记录该指纹和温度参数。 基于内容寻址的快照和索引将保存对应的提示。

sents.en: Prompt fingerprinting would identify system instructions and the schema with a SHA-256 hash and record the fingerprint and temperature for each analysis.
sents.zh: 提示指纹识别将通过 SHA-256 哈希来识别系统指令和模式，并为每次分析记录该指纹和温度参数。

sents.en: Content-addressed snapshots and an index would preserve the corresponding prompts.
sents.zh: 基于内容寻址的快照和索引将保存对应的提示。

paragraphs.en: Schema versioning would record a semantic schema_version , define how readers handle missing versions, and document changes in a changelog. The proposed default for a missing version is 1.0.0 1.0.0 .
paragraphs.zh: 模式版本控制会记录一个语义化的 schema_version，定义读取方如何处理缺失版本的情况，并在变更日志中记录变更。 针对缺失版本的提议默认值是 1.0.0 1.0.0。

sents.en: Schema versioning would record a semantic schema_version , define how readers handle missing versions, and document changes in a changelog.

sents.en: The proposed default for a missing version is 1.0.0 1.0.0 .

paragraphs.en: A codebook would document archive, store, and CSV fields, permitted labels, and flags.
paragraphs.zh: 代码簿（codebook）将记录档案、存储和 CSV 字段、允许的标签以及标志。

paragraphs.en: These mechanisms describe the provenance design. Their implementation and historical use are not established for the reported snapshot. Missing metadata cannot be reconstructed merely by assigning a version or hashing the current prompt. Full reconstruction of an earlier run requires its actual inputs, method version, and selection records.
paragraphs.zh: 这些机制描述了溯源设计。 对于所报告的快照，其实现和历史使用情况尚未确定。 缺失的元数据无法仅通过分配版本号或对当前提示进行哈希来重建。 完整重建早期的一次运行需要其真实输入、方法版本和选择记录。

sents.zh: 这些机制描述了溯源设计。

paragraphs.en: The TypeScript evaluation code implements the following measures:
paragraphs.zh: TypeScript 评估代码实现了以下措施：

paragraphs.en: Outlet-level lean correlation: means derived from the lean labels on [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] are compared with predefined reference ratings using Pearson r r and Spearman ρ \rho .
paragraphs.zh: 门店层面的精益相关性：将由 [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] 上的精益标签得到的均值与预先定义的参考评分进行比较，采用 Pearson r r 和 Spearman ρ \rho 。

paragraphs.en: Inter-annotator agreement: Cohen’s κ \kappa for sentiment and lean when two sets of human annotations are available, together with model–human agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 标注者间一致性：当存在两套人工标注时，报告情感与倾向上的 Cohen's κ \kappa，以及模型与人类之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Topic-clustering agreement: adjusted Rand index and Fowlkes–Mallows between human true_topic labels and cluster assignments.
paragraphs.zh: 主题聚类一致性：人类 true_topic 标签与聚类分配之间的调整兰德指数（adjusted Rand index）和 Fowlkes–Mallows 指数。

paragraphs.en: Mean Critic grounding score: the arithmetic mean of eligible verification_score values.
paragraphs.zh: Mean Critic grounding score：符合条件的 verification_score 值的算术平均值。

paragraphs.en: The reference ratings are approximate comparison values. Their presence in an evaluation file does not establish their provenance or independent validity, and it does not show that they were supplied to the Analyst or Critic for calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 参考评级是近似的比较值。 它们出现在评估文件中并不能证明其来源或独立有效性，也不能表明它们曾提供给智能体（Analyst 或 Critic）用于校准。

sents.en: Their presence in an evaluation file does not establish their provenance or independent validity, and it does not show that they were supplied to the Analyst or Critic for calibration.

paragraphs.en: A real-model evaluation requires explicit provider, model, duplicate, missing-label, and minimum-sample rules. The current default harness does not by itself enforce the reported exclusion of mock analyses or the two-article threshold. It also rounds outlet means before computing correlations. Full-precision means should be used for a reproducible statistical calculation, with rounding applied only for display.
paragraphs.zh: 真实模型评估需要明确的提供商、模型、重复项、缺失标签以及最小样本量规则。 当前的默认测试框架本身并不能强制执行所报告的对模拟分析的排除或两篇文章的阈值。 它还会在计算相关性之前对媒体渠道的均值进行四舍五入。 应使用全精度均值进行可复现的统计计算，四舍五入仅用于显示。

paragraphs.en: The treatment of not-determinable also needs to be stated. The implementation maps it to zero, which is not equivalent to a model judgment of center . paragraphs.en: Limitations. The reported evaluation covers fifteen outlets, several represented by only a few articles, and a single underlying model. The reference ratings are approximate and predefined. Their sources and assignment procedures require further verification. Correlations describe association and relative ordering, not absolute agreement in lean scores. The Analyst and Critic may share systematic biases and errors. A Critic score records the model’s assessment of support in the supplied text; it does not establish factual correctness or independent verification. Incomplete historical metadata limits reconstruction of earlier evaluations, and repeated records and unspecified selection rules can affect the reported means. Lightweight lexical clustering can separate reports of the same event when their wording differs or merge distinct events when their wording is similar.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 所报告的评估覆盖十五个媒体渠道，其中若干渠道仅由少数几篇文章代表，且仅使用单一底层模型。 参考评级是近似的且预先设定的。 其来源与分配程序需要进一步核实。 相关性描述的是关联与相对排序，而非立场得分上的绝对一致。 分析智能体与批评智能体可能共享系统性的偏差与错误。 批评智能体的分数记录的是模型对所提供文本中支持情况的评估；它并不能确立事实正确性或进行独立验证。 历史元数据不完整限制了对早期评估的重构，且重复记录与未明确的选取规则可能影响所报告的均值。 轻量级词汇聚类在措辞不同时可能拆分同一事件的报道，或在措辞相似时合并不同的事件。

paragraphs.en: Ethics. The interface presents quoted passages and possible omissions so that readers can examine the basis of an interpretation. It treats lean as relative to other coverage and identifies the reference ratings as approximate. Such tools can still be used to make unsupported accusations of partisanship. Quotation access and instructions against accusations of lying are intended to support review; they do not ensure that every output is defensible. Related work suggests that carefully designed AI interactions can reduce unfounded beliefs [ 15 ] , but that finding does not establish the effect of this prototype.
paragraphs.zh: 伦理。 该界面呈现引文段落以及可能的省略之处，以便读者审视某一解读的依据。 它将“偏颇程度”视为相对于其他报道而言，并指出参考评分仅为近似值。 这类工具仍可能被用来做出缺乏依据的党派偏袒指控。 提供引文访问以及针对撒谎指控的指引，旨在支持审核；它们并不能确保每一条输出都站得住脚。 相关工作表明，经过精心设计的人工智能交互可以减少无根据的信念 [ 15 ]，但该发现并不能证实这一原型的实际效果。

paragraphs.en: Prototype status. Summaries and framing analyses are generated automatically, and aggregate statistics are computed programmatically. The original articles come from external publishers. Outputs may contain errors, omissions, or biased interpretations and should be checked against the linked sources. This is an experimental research prototype, with additional functionality under development. Future work will extend the existing evaluation harness through stronger provenance tracking, broader testing, and independent human assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 原型状态。 摘要与框架性分析由系统自动生成，汇总统计数据通过程序计算得出。 原始文章来自外部出版方。 输出内容可能包含错误、遗漏或有偏差的解读，应对照所链接的来源进行核查。 这是一个实验性研究原型，更多功能正在开发中。 未来的工作将通过更强的来源溯源追踪、更广泛的测试以及独立的人工评估来扩展现有的评估框架。

paragraphs.en: The reported outlet correlation ( r = 0.76 r=0.76 ) and mean Critic score ( 0.52 0.52 ) are preliminary. The original evaluation requires further work on snapshot identity, subset selection, and reference-rating provenance. The Critic’s score measures model-assessed source support, and the current workflow does not restrict Reporter inputs to Critic-approved material. Further evaluation needs independent human annotations and a fully traceable archive.
paragraphs.zh: 所报告的媒体机构相关性（ r = 0.76 r=0.76 ）和平均 Critic 评分（ 0.52 0.52 ）属于初步结果。 最初的评估需要在快照同一性、子集选择和参考评分来源方面进一步开展工作。 Critic 的评分衡量的是模型评估的来源支持度，而当前工作流程并未将 Reporter 的输入限制为经 Critic 认可的材料。 进一步的评估需要独立的人工标注和完全可追溯的存档。
